diffs.diff: differential input biopotential (mV): datasheet reading gives 10 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The AD8232 is a purely analog front end with no ADC, no digital output and no 'counts': datasheet p.1 'Fully integrated single-lead ECG front end ... High signal gain (G = 100) with dc blocking capabilities ... Accepts up to ±300 mV of half cell potential'; spec table 'DC Differential Input Range VDIFF -300 +300 mV'. OUTPUT is an analog voltage (input x gain, 1100 on the SparkFun SEN-12650, centred on REFOUT = VS/2), which the model already describes; the host board's ADC scaling depends on the MCU, so a fixed '10 mV per count, offset -15' conversion has no basis in the datasheet. The model correctly has no counts-to-mV conversion and simulates OUTPUT as an analog voltage centred at 1.65 V.
